process_area.title: Freight Sourcing, Carrier Contracting & Rate Management

value_stream.name: Freight Procurement, Carrier Management & Freight Audit

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06), Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), FP&A (links to VS-17.4/VS-33.1), Treasury (links to VS-18), Supply Planning (links to VS-02)
fields.Trigger: Annual procurement/SCM planning (links to VS-33.1); spend-review cycle

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/Procurement build the freight-spend baseline and category strategy" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "Logistics/Supply Planning set the freight-service requirements and lane network" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Logistics/FP&A set the freight cost-reduction targets and the carrier-base" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-559 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Sourcing, Carrier Contracting & Rate Management (PA-110.1).)
- operational: consolidated spend baseline; operational: joint logistics/SCM planning
Pain Points / Risks: - **Spend-opacity risk**: Fragmented freight spend across legs/POs obscures the total; mitigated by consolidated spend baseline
- **Target-misalignment risk**: Cost targets conflict with service requirements; mitigated by joint logistics/SCM planning
System Touchpoints: - Freight-spend/BI (links to VS-28.1); S&OP (links to VS-02.1); DC network (links to VS-04); budget (links to VS-33.1/VS-17.4); commodity/fuel (links to VS-106/VS-61); procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34)

steps.activity: Logistics/Procurement build the freight-spend baseline and category strategy: spend by leg (import ocean, drayage, inbound vendor→DC/DSD, inter-DC/inter-island, DC→store, last-mile), by carrier, by lane/region, by mode, and by cost element (line-haul, fuel surcharge, accessorial); identify consolidation, mode-shift, and carrier-rationalization opportunities

Logistics/Supply Planning set the freight-service requirements and lane network: required transit/lead times (links to VS-02 lead times), service frequencies, capacity needs (TEUs/month, replenishment orders/month links to profile §7), network design (DC catchments links to VS-04), and island/region constraints (links to W66); align to the S&OP (links to VS-02.1) and demand (links to VS-02)

Logistics/FP&A set the freight cost-reduction targets and the carrier-base strategy (core carriers, capacity tiers, framework vs spot), align to the budget (links to VS-33.1/VS-17.4) and commodity/fuel outlook (links to VS-106/VS-61), and approve the sourcing plan (W3498); report to governance (W3520/W110 review)

fields.Participants: Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Logistics (links to VS-06), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Insurance/Risk (links to VS-26), HSE (links to VS-24), Carrier/3PL
fields.Volume: Carrier base across all legs (~dozens of carriers/3PLs)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics run the carrier/3PL RFQ" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "Procurement/Logistics evaluate bids" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-route of "route selected carriers to contracting" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-559 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Sourcing, Carrier Contracting & Rate Management (PA-110.1).)
- operational: total-cost and SLA scoring; operational: dual-sourcing core carriers
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-bid risk**: Lowest rate masks poor service/hidden accessorials; mitigated by total-cost and SLA scoring
- **Carrier-concentration risk**: Over-reliance on one carrier per lane; mitigated by dual-sourcing core carriers
System Touchpoints: - Procurement/vendor (links to VS-03/VS-34); legal (links to VS-100.3); insurance (links to VS-26); HSE (links to VS-24); IT/EDI (links to VS-27)

steps.activity: Procurement/Logistics run the carrier/3PL RFQ: define lane/volume/service specs per leg, issue RFP to qualified carriers and 3PLs (links to VS-03 methodology), pre-qualify on capability (equipment, coverage, capacity), financial stability, insurance, safety/regulatory record (links to VS-26/VS-24), and references

Procurement/Logistics evaluate bids: rate per lane/mode, fuel/accessorial structure, transit/lead time, capacity commitment, SLA, technology (track-and-trace, EDI/API links to VS-27), and total cost; score and short-list; manage a balanced core-carrier panel per lane

Procurement/Legal recommend award per authority (links to VS-36), manage framework/master agreements where volume warrants, and route selected carriers to contracting (W3499) and onboarding (W3504); log the award and feed the routing guide (W3500)

fields.Participants: Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Logistics (links to VS-06), Finance (links to VS-40/VS-17), Carrier/3PL

workflows.name: Carrier Contracting, Rate Negotiation & Tariff Structures

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics negotiate the rate structure per carrier/leg" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track contract compliance and savings vs baseline" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-559 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Sourcing, Carrier Contracting & Rate Management (PA-110.1).)
- operational: total-cost modeling and audit (W3513); operational: balanced formula (W3519)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Rate-opaqueness risk**: Complex accessorial structures obscure true cost; mitigated by total-cost modeling and audit (W3513)
- **Fuel-clause risk**: Poor fuel/index mechanism passes volatility to BuildRight; mitigated by balanced formula (W3519)
System Touchpoints: - TMS/ERP rate master (links to VS-27/W1166); legal/contract (links to VS-100.3/W402); insurance (links to VS-26); multi-entity (links to VS-72); freight audit (links to W3513)

steps.activity: Procurement/Logistics negotiate the rate structure per carrier/leg: point-to-point rates, zone/mileage-based rates (per-km by vehicle type links to W1166), minimum charge, FAK (freight-all-kind) vs commodity rate, accessorial schedule (detention, demurrage, layover, loading/unloading, fuel surcharge formula), and volume rebates; benchmark vs market (links to VS-57 methodology)

Legal/Procurement structure and execute the contract: term, capacity commitment and volume tier, SLA (links to VS-56/W1371), liability/cargo insurance limits (links to VS-26), claims process (W3511), fuel/index mechanism (W3519), termination, and dispute resolution (links to VS-100.3); ensure multi-entity applicability (links to VS-72)

Procurement/Logistics load the contracted rates/tariff into the TMS/ERP (links to VS-27/W1166), publish the rate-effective date, and integrate to the routing guide (W3500) and freight-audit baseline (W3513); track contract compliance and savings vs baseline (W3518)

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06), Supply Planning (links to VS-02), Procurement (links to VS-03), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Carrier

workflows.name: Routing Guide, Carrier Compliance & Lane Assignment

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics publish the routing guide" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag of "flags for off-guide routing, approval workflow for exceptions, and capture of…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Logistics/Procurement monitor routing-guide compliance, carrier share per lane, off-guide" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-78 (ensure freight invoice accuracy & carrier compliance.)
- operational: system enforcement and exception approval; operational: enforcement and exception approval; operational: maintenance discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Off-guide-routing risk**: Unauthorized routing inflates cost and breaks audit; mitigated by system enforcement and exception approval
- **Guide-staleness risk**: Outdated guide routes to expired rates/lanes; mitigated by maintenance discipline
System Touchpoints: - TMS/routing guide (links to VS-27); PO/SO (links to VS-03.2/VS-11/VS-10); dock scheduling (links to VS-04/W585); carrier scorecard (links to VS-67/W3512)

steps.activity: Logistics publish the routing guide: preferred carrier(s) and mode per origin→destination lane (vendor→DC, vendor→store DSD, DC→store, DC→DC, DC/store→customer, port→DC drayage), rate reference, packaging/handling requirements, appointment/dock rules (links to VS-04/W585), and documentation requirements; cascade to vendors (W3502) and internal teams

Logistics/IT enforce the routing guide at tender (W3501): system-suggested carrier per lane, compliance flags for off-guide routing, approval workflow for exceptions, and capture of routing-deviation reason and cost impact; integrate to PO (links to VS-03.2) and SO (links to VS-11/VS-10)

Logistics/Procurement monitor routing-guide compliance, carrier share per lane, off-guide spend, and capacity/utilization; rebalance carrier assignments and update the guide as rates/lanes change (W3499); report compliance and off-guide cost to the carrier scorecard (W3512) and review (W3520)

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Carrier/3PL, Procurement (links to VS-03)
fields.Trigger: Shipment ready (links to VS-04/VS-06); routing guide (W3500)

workflows.name: Freight Tendering, Spot Quote & Capacity Booking

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/DC tender the shipment to the routing-guide carrier" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document the spot exception and reason" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-dispatch of "Logistics confirm booking, dispatch" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-559 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Sourcing, Carrier Contracting & Rate Management (PA-110.1).)
- operational: routing-guide authority documented; spot exceptions approved and logged per lane
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capacity-shortfall risk**: Peak/typhoon demand exceeds contracted capacity; mitigated by spot process and capacity planning
- **Tender-inefficiency risk**: Manual tendering delays shipment and inflates cost; mitigated by automated TMS tendering
System Touchpoints: - TMS/tender (links to VS-27); carrier EDI/API; dock scheduling (links to VS-04/W585); track-and-trace (links to W3508); freight audit (links to W3513)

steps.activity: Logistics/DC tender the shipment to the routing-guide carrier (W3500): automated tender via TMS/EDI/API (links to VS-27), shipment details (origin/destination, weight/cube, commodity, required pickup/delivery), rate confirmation, and capacity booking; manage accept/decline and fallback to next-preferred carrier

For off-guide, overflow, or peak capacity, Logistics procure spot/spot-quote capacity: solicit spot quotes from approved carriers/brokers, evaluate rate/transit, book per authority, and document the spot exception and reason; manage peak-season (Ber-months, typhoon recovery links to VS-69) capacity

Logistics confirm booking, dispatch (links to W1165 last-mile/W3505 outbound), track the shipment (W3508), and capture the rate basis (contract vs spot) for freight audit (W3513); manage load consolidation (W3507) and tender efficiency

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-04), Procurement (links to VS-03), Vendor (links to VS-03.4 portal), DC Operations (links to VS-04), AP (links to VS-15)
fields.Trigger: PO placement (links to VS-03.2); routing guide (W3500)

workflows.name: Inbound Freight Management & Vendor Routing Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/Procurement set inbound routing terms per PO" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "Logistics/Vendor manage inbound execution" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report vendor routing compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-78 (ensure freight invoice accuracy & carrier compliance.)
- operational: routing instructions and chargeback; operational: ASN and tracking (W3508)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Routing-non-compliance risk**: Vendors route off-guide, inflating cost; mitigated by routing instructions and chargeback
- **Inbound-blindspot risk**: Poor inbound visibility causes DC congestion and stockouts; mitigated by ASN and tracking (W3508)
System Touchpoints: - PO/vendor portal (links to VS-03.2/VS-03.4); ASN (links to VS-03.4); dock scheduling (links to VS-04/W585); receiving (links to VS-04.1); AP/landed cost (links to VS-15/W3515); chargeback (links to VS-03/W245)

steps.activity: Logistics/Procurement set inbound routing terms per PO: BuildRight-controlled freight (collect/own routing guide W3500) vs prepaid/vendor-controlled, incoterm (links to VS-87/W2560), and vendor routing instructions (carrier, mode, packaging, appointment links to VS-04/W585); communicate via the vendor portal (links to VS-03.4) and PO

Logistics/Vendor manage inbound execution: ASN (links to VS-03.4), pickup scheduling, in-transit visibility (W3508), dock appointment (links to VS-04/W585), and receiving (links to VS-04.1/W1365); manage DSD bulky freight (cement/lumber/sand per profile §7.1) and direct-store appointments

Logistics/AP manage inbound freight cost responsibility and chargeback: collect-vs-prepaid reconciliation, vendor non-compliance chargeback (off-guide, late, packaging links to VS-03/W245), freight cost capture to landed cost (W3515), and dispute resolution (links to VS-90); report vendor routing compliance (W3512)

fields.Participants: Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-02.2), Import/Customs (links to VS-87), Procurement (links to VS-03), Freight Forwarder/NVOCC, Shipping Line, Customs Broker (links to VS-87)

workflows.name: Import Ocean Freight, Forwarder & NVOCC Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics/Procurement manage the ocean-freight program" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "Logistics/Forwarder manage the import shipment lifecycle" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile the forwarder invoice" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-559 (ensure controlled execution — Freight Sourcing, Carrier Contracting & Rate Management (PA-110.1).)
- operational: contracts and forward-booking (links to W1422); operational: drayage planning (W3509/W249)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Space-allocation risk**: Peak-season space shortage delays imports; mitigated by contracts and forward-booking (links to W1422)
- **Demurrage/detention risk**: Port/yard delays incur charges; mitigated by drayage planning (W3509/W249)
System Touchpoints: - Import/customs (links to VS-02.2/VS-87); ocean-freight/forwarder; container yard (links to VS-04/W222); landed cost (links to VS-17/W275/W3515); track-and-trace (links to W3508)

steps.activity: Logistics/Procurement manage the ocean-freight program: shipping-line contracts (FCL) and NVOCC/forwarder relationships (LCL), port-pair lanes (China/Taiwan/Indonesia/Malaysia/Japan/Europe → Manila/Cebu/CDO), BAF/rate negotiation, space allocation in peak season, and carrier performance; integrate to the import plan (links to VS-02.2/W1422 forward-buy)

Logistics/Forwarder manage the import shipment lifecycle: booking, BL/telex-release, container stuffing/origin, ocean transit, arrival notice, drayage to DC (links to VS-04/W222 yard), and customs clearance (links to VS-87/W2560); track in-transit (W3508) and manage demurrage/detention (W3509/W249)

Logistics/Finance capture the import landed-cost components (ocean freight, BAF, THC, drayage, duty, customs broker, insurance links to VS-87/W3515) to the PO/item for inventory valuation (links to VS-17/W275), reconcile the forwarder invoice (W3513), and report import-freight cost and transit performance (W3512)

fields.Participants: Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Logistics (links to VS-06), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Insurance/Risk (links to VS-26), HSE (links to VS-24), Compliance (links to VS-22/VS-87), Master Data (links to VS-29)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "onboard the carrier/3PL" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate rate and capability" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "maintain ongoing compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-78 (ensure freight invoice accuracy & carrier compliance.)
- operational: insurance tracking (links to VS-26); operational: renewal tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Uninsured-carrier risk**: Lapsed cargo insurance shifts loss to BuildRight; mitigated by insurance tracking (links to VS-26)
- **Accreditation-lapse risk**: Expired franchise/CPC halts operations; mitigated by renewal tracking
System Touchpoints: - Vendor master (links to VS-29/W16); TMS rate master (links to W1166); insurance (links to VS-26); compliance (links to VS-22/VS-24/VS-87); EDI/API (links to VS-27); AP/bank (links to VS-15/VS-18)

steps.activity: Procurement/Logistics onboard the carrier/3PL: business registration (SEC/DTI), tax (BIR links to VS-79), transport franchise/CPC/LTFRB for trucks, customs accreditation where import-relevant (links to VS-87), driver/vehicle accreditation (links to W1373), insurance certificates (cargo, CTPL, third-party links to VS-26), and HSE/safety record (links to VS-24)

Procurement/Master Data set up the carrier in the vendor master (links to VS-29/W16), TMS rate master (links to W3499/W1166), EDI/API integration (links to VS-27), bank/payment (links to VS-15/VS-18), and the routing guide (W3500); validate rate and capability

Procurement/Insurance maintain ongoing compliance: insurance renewal tracking (links to VS-26), franchise/accreditation renewals, safety/regulatory updates (links to VS-22/VS-24), periodic re-qualification, and offboarding (deactivate, final settlement, data per privacy links to VS-91); feed the carrier scorecard (W3512)
